falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score closes above 70 (from 36) on any session in the next 14 days while the engine's primary risk basket is up more than 8% from today's close
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The tape is a late-cycle blowoff, not an unresolved base; UNKNOWN/HOLD and the bottom_2022_may_luna analog are both wrong

falsification_conditions.condition: Pattern match to bottom_2022_may_luna falls below 50% and the primary risk asset closes more than 12% below the anchor low used for that match
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The May-2022 bottom analog has failed; downside was the classifiable regime and HOLD/UNKNOWN missed a breakdown

falsification_conditions.condition: Pattern match to bottom_2022_may_luna stays at or above 80% and the primary risk asset closes more than 10% above the analog low with VIX below 16
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom analog confirmed; the correct call was risk-on, so UNKNOWN/HOLD is invalidated by a resolved bullish regime

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
